name: Mishmash Bakery
description:
Established in 2014, Mishmash Bakery is one of India's premium bakeries, serving a variety of customised celebration cakes along with a range of exotic sweet & savoury fusion gourmet delights and rich, healthy versions of dessert jars, brownies, cupcakes, cookies, teacakes, breads and many more.

Run by Chef Shikha Murarka, who is certified by top bakers around the world, Mishmash Bakery excels in mixing the 'science' of baking with the unadulterated, underrated, joyful 'emotion' behind it. The result? A wholesome, indulgent and soulful celebration of food.

featured_reviews.name: Shefali Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered Korean buns & her strawberry entremet from Shikha@ mishmash bakery , Mumbai.
Goodies were hand carried from Mumbai to Gurgaon which means they were travelled 8 hours to finallyreach home.
The buns were utterly butterly delicious perfect kick for the morning or any day time snack.infact i had Korean buns in gurgaon at well known eateries but was both times disappointed.

I can't thank her enough the entremet was just out of the world and hats off to the creavity that withstood 8 hours journey in this climate.knowing entremet is a delicate dessert and needs cold temp thru out even for transit.But this beauty just came in right. It get get little distorted but it was still beautiful and we couldn't wait to devour it.
It was just perfect right from the pink color to the taste, the layering , the presentation couldn't have asked for more.
Must try for mumbaikars and foodies who are willing to take them home ✈️ .

Look forward to try out more now soon.
Thanks a lot Shikha for making our weekend sweet and special.
Love

featured_reviews.name: Yoshita Harchandani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our weekend couldn't get any sweetier with this delicious box of assorted brownies from Mishmash Bakery. They are just incredible & baking real good stuff with all the love❤️

Here's what we tried, and we think even you should without any second thoughts! 😄

👉🏻 Blueberry Cheesecake Blondie - A rich cheesecake filling and a tangy blueberry compote are swirled through gooey white chocolate blondies…No ifs or buts – try them now!

👉🏻 Kitkat Brownies - Deliciously thick and fudgy chocolate brownies that are stuffed with whole KitKats, and generously topped with broken KitKats. These are seriously the ultimate KitKat brownies, and you are gonna absolutely love them!

👉🏻 Nutella Brownies - Fabulous thick magic of nutella topped with hazelnuts is sure to take you to a wonderland! Need I say more? 😉

👉🏻 Cookie Dough Brownie - Its probably a nice way to enjoy cookie & brownie together in one! They’re super thick and fudgy, they’re rich in flavour, and they are loaded with chocolate chips.

Can you handle the rich fudginess of these brownies? 🥺
If you’re looking to try brownies that's next level, you neeeed to try it from Mishmash, Right now!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Huge thank you to the amazing Shikha for baking the most delicious and adorable cake for my little one’s second birthday! 💚🦕 It looked exactly like the reference I sent—down to the tiniest detail—and tasted even better than it looked (if that’s even possible!).

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Kotian
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m extremely disappointed with J Hearsch & Co. in Bandra. Despite being an old and reputed establishment, their quality, service, and overall experience have gone drastically downhill.

To begin with, the staff—especially the owner—were shockingly rude. It’s as if they believe they’re the only bakery that exists just because they’ve been around a while. Sadly, that attitude is exactly why this was my last visit.

Yes, the place has a legacy, but that doesn’t mean you stop upgrading where it matters. Instead of improving service and food quality, they’ve only focused on increasing their prices while everything else has degraded. The quantity has reduced significantly, and the quality is no longer what it used to be.

Here’s what I ordered:
•	Chicken Burger
•	Chicken Samosa
•	Mutton Samosa
•	Mutton Puff
•	Chicken Roll
•	Lime Water

The burger used to come with wafers in a decent box—now it’s wrapped in flimsy paper. The lime water, which once had good quantity for a reasonable price, is now expensive (₹100) and barely enough. Most items were just okay, but not worth the price or the hassle.

There is no seating, no parking, and still, customers are expected to follow a long list of rules. Instead of focusing on unnecessary regulations, they should really work on their customer service, which is currently pathetic.

Honestly, there’s no point in putting in so much effort to visit a place where the staff behaves rudely and the food no longer justifies the hype or price. I won’t be returning, and I certainly won’t recommend this bakery to anyone. Keep your attitude—I’ll take my business elsewhere.

Today, we went to Deliure around 8:00 PM and placed our order. The staff told us it would take 40–45 minutes. Despite the long delay, we waited patiently as we are regular customers. While we were sitting inside, a major parking issue was unfolding outside. It was entirely Deliure’s fault because they failed to arrange proper parking management, which caused a lot of trouble for the locals and led to a massive traffic jam. Consequently, people complained to the police. The local police and traffic police arrived at the scene and took two of Deliure's managers to the police station.
When we finally walked outside, we found that our vehicle had been fined. This happened even though we had parked our vehicle exactly where the Deliure staff had instructed us to. When we went back inside to confront the Deliure management about this, they bluntly told us that they were not responsible for the fine, and their behaviour towards us was extremely rude.
They could have easily informed us about the ongoing parking issue with the police while we were waiting inside for our order, and they could have asked us to move our vehicle. However, they chose not to do so, and because of their negligence, we ended up with a fine. Do we really deserve this treatment? We waited so long for our food, and in return, we had to pay a fine! Is this how they respect their regular customers?
Furthermore, this entire parking chaos and heavy order load escalated because Deliure was prioritizing online orders over offline walk-in customers. Their mentality is crystal clear—they only care about making money from online orders, making offline customers wait indefinitely, and leaving them in deep trouble when their vehicles get fined due to the establishment's mismanagement.
